note: The fvar table supplies the input-controlled named instance count used to advertise variation instances.
The font's instance coordinate records are compared against the axis defaults; this candidate omits a matching default record.
The face advertises one more named instance than the number of instance records physically present in fvar, creating a synthesized default instance.
The adjusted named instance count is propagated from style_flags into the GX variation structure setup.
The setup loop initializes coordinate pointers for every advertised named style, including the synthesized default beyond the original fvar records.
When the default instance is synthesized at the first index after the real fvar records, the code writes an FT_Var_Named_Style entry at that extra advertised slot.
